name: PixelcraftDev Addons for Elementor (Lite)
author: superauu

sections.description:
Enhance your Elementor page building experience with PixelcraftDev Addons. This comprehensive collection provides creative and professional widgets to boost your design functionality, including Social Share with LINE support, Easy Card, Image Popup, Accordion, and Dual Buttons.

External services

The Social Share widget integrates with third-party social endpoints:
* WhatsApp: https://api.whatsapp.com (Shares current page URL/Title)
* LINE: https://line.me (Shares current page URL/Title)

LINE Legal documents:
* Terms of Service: https://terms.line.me/
* Privacy Policy: https://line.me/en/terms/policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pixelcraftdev-addons-for-elementor-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Access the ‘PixelcraftDev’ category in the Elementor editor to add widgets to your pages.
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor Free?

Yes, it works perfectly with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Is it mobile friendly?

Absolutely! All widgets are fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices.
